new_findings.text: The three-tier Reinforce is a v0.717 CODE fact, and the two UPHELD findings that call the material '1 Silver Ore' are wrong. The web build's own reinforce action carries the price and all three reagents as literals: §1t401s0§.as:1087 'cost = 5000;', then it demands and spends stat 20064 when weaponlevel < 30 (:1112, :1120), 20065 when < 60 (:1124, :1132) and 20066 otherwise (:1136, :1144), before charging -cost at :1146 and setting weapon.uses = 0 at :1147. itemdata.xml:10420/10429/10438 give those ids names 4241/4242/4243 = Silver Ore / Titanium Ore / Uncut Diamond. This matters twice: it discharges the S0-3 build-parity hedge that every reinforce finding so far has carried (they all read the tiers out of the ANDROID string table), and it refutes UPHELD economy/reinforce-weapon-cost-is-a-held-constant-5000 ('5000 coins plus 1 Silver Ore') and the two-tier clause of UPHELD payload/repair-cost-formula-is-node-level-times-10 ('1 Silver Ore under weapon level 30, 1 Titanium Ore at 30+'). There are three tiers, in the target build, in code.

new_findings.text: Settles a contradiction between two findings that both claim RR:201. s26c/the-271-cap-IS-the-shipped-level-80-base-stat-cap says 271 'is unreachable in one stat ... the panel stops granting'; UPHELD progression/271-cap-explained says it 'IS reachable in one stat on a first run'. The arithmetic is entirely inside one function and settles it for the second: §1t5957s0§.as:3457 computes the ATK points already spent as (ATK - 1) / 3, which pins base ATK = 1 and the step = 3; :3422 confirms the step ('§1t9713s0§(...§1t9408s0§,3)'); :3461 sets the entire first-run budget to (level - 1) * 3, i.e. 237 at the level cap of 80; :3344 caps ATK at 1 + (level + 10) * 3 = 271. Lifting ATK from 1 to 271 costs (271 - 1) / 3 = 90 of 237 points, and the gate is a strict '<', so the last grant fires at 268 and lands exactly on 271. 271 is reachable in ONE stat with 147 points to spare. The ledger's parenthetical ('a 237-point first-run budget makes it impossible in one stat') is dead, and so is the same claim where the overturning finding repeats it.
new_findings.ledger_text: The "271 cap" is gear/rebirth-inclusive (237-point first-run budget makes it impossible in one stat) — resolvable by arithmetic now.
